page.restrictedTitle.where: Library page: heading shown to visitors who are not signed in

page.restrictedBody.where: Library page: explanation under the 'Restricted Access' heading

page.pendingTitle.where: Library page: heading shown to a signed-in user whose account is not yet approved

page.pendingBody.where: Library page: explanation under the 'Account Pending' heading

page.uid.where: Library page (account pending): small monospace box with the start of the user's id
page.uid.context: {uid} is the first 8 characters of the user's account id (machine text). 'UID' is an abbreviation for user id.

header.back.where: Library page header: back-arrow button (screen-reader label)

header.exitSelectMode.where: Library page header: tooltip of the checkbox button while multi-select mode is on

header.selectFiles.where: Library page header: tooltip of the checkbox button that turns on multi-select mode

header.uploadDone.where: Library page: toast after a chart upload finishes

search.audioPlaceholder.where: Library page: search box placeholder on the Audio tab

search.audioLabel.where: Library page: search box screen-reader label on the Audio tab

search.chartsPlaceholder.where: Library page: search box placeholder on chart tabs

search.chartsLabel.where: Library page: search box screen-reader label on chart tabs

usage.partial.where: Library page: warning line when 'last used' data failed to load for some charts
usage.partial.context: 'recency filter' = the filter chip that shows charts by when they were last played.

usage.retry.where: Library page: button next to the 'last used' warning that reloads the data

sections.groupLabel.where: Library page: screen-reader label of the row of section tabs (collections)

sections.tabWithCount.where: Library page: one section tab (a chart collection) with its chart count
sections.tabWithCount.context: {label} is the collection's name from the congregation's settings (not translated); {n} is the number of charts in it.

sections.audioWithCount.where: Library page: the Audio section tab with the number of audio files

shared.chipGroupLabel.where: Library page and Perform swap-for-tonight sheet: screen-reader label of the row of chips for collections other congregations share

shared.chipGroupHeading.where: Library page: visible label (with colon) before the shared-collection chips

shared.chipAria.where: Library page and Perform swap-for-tonight sheet: screen-reader label of one shared-collection chip
shared.chipAria.context: {label} is the collection's name; {owner} is the name of the congregation that shares it.

shared.fromOwner.where: Library page and Perform swap-for-tonight sheet: small badge on a shared chip or chart row naming who shares it
shared.fromOwner.context: {owner} is the name of the congregation that shares the chart.

shared.readOnly.where: Library page: tooltip and disabled menu line on a chart shared by another congregation
shared.readOnly.context: {owner} is the sharing congregation's name. 'it' = the chart (sheet-music file).

shared.loadFailed.where: Library page: status text when shared collections could not be loaded

allSites.label.where: Library page (admins only): screen-reader label of the 'All sites' switch
allSites.label.context: 'sites' = the other congregations hosted on the platform.

allSites.off.where: Library page (admins only): switch text when off

allSites.on.where: Library page (admins only): switch text when on

list.errorTitle.where: Library page: error box title when the library failed to load

list.errorFallback.where: Library page: error box text when no detail is available

list.noMatchesTitle.where: Library page: empty list title when the search finds nothing

list.noMatchesBody.where: Library page: empty list text when the search finds nothing

list.noAudioTitle.where: Library page: empty Audio tab title

list.noAudioBody.where: Library page: empty Audio tab text
list.noAudioBody.context: '.mp3, .m4a' are file extensions — keep as is. 'Drive' = Google Drive.

list.noChartsTitle.where: Library page: empty list title when the library has no charts

list.noChartsBody.where: Library page: empty list text when the library has no charts

list.chartCount.where: Library page: screen-reader announcement of how many charts the list shows

filters.key.where: Library page: filter chip for musical key
filters.key.context: Musical key (C, G, Bb...), not a keyboard key.

filters.keyWithCount.where: Library page: musical-key filter chip with the number of keys selected

filters.topic.where: Library page: filter chip for song topic/theme

filters.topicWithCount.where: Library page: topic filter chip with the number of topics selected

filters.recency.where: Library page: filter chip for when a chart was last played (no filter set)

filters.recent.where: Library page: recency chip when filtered to recently played

filters.stale.where: Library page: recency chip when filtered to charts not played for 60+ days

filters.never.where: Library page: recency chip when filtered to charts never played

filters.clear.where: Library page: chip that clears all filters

filters.optionRecent.where: Library page: recency option, played in the last 30 days

filters.optionStale.where: Library page: recency option, last played more than 60 days ago

filters.optionNever.where: Library page: recency option, never played in a setlist

row.openFolderLabel.where: Library row: screen-reader label of a folder row

row.playLabel.where: Library row: screen-reader label of an audio row (not playing)

row.pauseLabel.where: Library row: screen-reader label of an audio row that is playing

row.viewLabel.where: Library row: screen-reader label of a chart row (opens it)

row.audio.where: Library row: small badge on audio files

row.bpm.context: {bpm} is a number; 'bpm' = beats per minute.

row.cachedTitle.where: Library row: tooltip of the 'Cached' badge

row.cached.where: Library row: badge on charts saved on this device for offline use

row.lastUsedTitle.where: Library row: tooltip of the 'last used' badge
row.lastUsedTitle.context: {date} is the raw date the chart was last in a setlist.

row.usageBadge.where: Library row: compact badge with the last date a chart was played and how many times
row.usageBadge.context: {date} is a short date like 'Jan 31'; {uses} is the number of times played; '×' means 'times'.

row.usageBadgeNoDate.where: Library row: compact usage badge when the date is unknown
row.usageBadgeNoDate.context: {uses} is the number of times played; '×' means 'times'.

row.digitizing.where: Library row and its menu: shown while AI converts a PDF chart to MusicXML

row.openFolder.where: Library row: menu item on a folder

row.play.where: Library row: menu item on an audio file

row.selectView.where: Library row: menu item that opens a chart

row.digitize.where: Library row (admins): menu item that converts a PDF chart to MusicXML with AI

row.rename.where: Library row (admins): menu item to rename a chart

row.archive.where: Library row (admins): menu item that hides a chart from the library

selection.clear.where: Library page: selection bar button that unselects everything

selection.copyNames.where: Library page: selection bar button that copies the selected charts' names to the clipboard

selection.copiedNames.where: Library page: toast after copying the selected names
selection.copiedNames.context: {count} = number of names copied. English intentionally keeps 'file names' for 1 too.

selection.addToSetlist.where: Library page: selection bar button that adds the selected charts to a setlist

actions.digitizingToast.where: Library: toast when AI conversion of a PDF chart starts
actions.digitizingToast.context: {name} is the file name. ~20s = about 20 seconds.

actions.digitizeTimeout.where: Library: error toast when AI conversion timed out

actions.digitizationFailed.where: Library: error toast when AI conversion failed

actions.serverError.where: Library: error toast with the server's raw response
actions.serverError.context: {status} is an HTTP status number; {detail} is the first 50 characters of the server's reply (machine text).

actions.savingMusicXml.where: Library: toast while the converted MusicXML file is saved
actions.savingMusicXml.context: MusicXML is a file format name — keep as is.

actions.saveXmlFailed.where: Library: error toast when saving the MusicXML file failed

actions.savedMusicXml.where: Library: success toast after AI conversion

actions.digitizeFailed.where: Library: generic error toast for AI conversion

actions.archiveConfirm.where: Library: browser confirm dialog before archiving a chart

actions.archiving.where: Library: toast while archiving a chart

actions.archived.where: Library: toast after a chart was archived

actions.archiveFailed.where: Library: error toast when archiving failed

actions.renamePrompt.where: Library: browser prompt asking for a chart's new name

actions.renaming.where: Library: toast while renaming a chart

actions.renamed.where: Library: toast after a chart was renamed

actions.renameFailed.where: Library: error toast when renaming failed

addSheet.title.where: Add-to-setlist sheet (bottom panel): title when adding one song

addSheet.titleMany.where: Add-to-setlist sheet: title when adding several songs

addSheet.searchLabel.where: Add-to-setlist sheet: search box screen-reader label

addSheet.newNamePlaceholder.where: Add-to-setlist sheet: placeholder of the new setlist name box
addSheet.newNamePlaceholder.context: 'Friday Night' is an example setlist name; translate as a natural example for a Friday-evening service.

addSheet.newNameLabel.where: Add-to-setlist sheet: new setlist name box screen-reader label

addSheet.create.where: Add-to-setlist sheet: button that creates the new setlist

addSheet.noMatch.where: Add-to-setlist sheet: empty state when the search finds no setlist

addSheet.noEditable.where: Add-to-setlist sheet: empty state when there are no setlists the user may edit

addSheet.songCount.where: Add-to-setlist sheet: number of songs in a setlist row
addSheet.songCount.context: {count} = number of songs. English intentionally says 'songs' for 1 too.

overlay.close.where: Song search overlay: close button screen-reader label

overlay.replacePlaceholder.where: Song search overlay: search placeholder when replacing a song in a setlist

overlay.replaceLabel.where: Song search overlay: search screen-reader label when replacing a song

overlay.addPlaceholder.where: Song search overlay: search placeholder when adding songs

overlay.addLabel.where: Song search overlay: search screen-reader label when adding songs

overlay.collectionGroup.where: Song search overlay: screen-reader label of the collection toggle

overlay.noResults.where: Song search overlay: empty state when the search finds nothing

overlay.empty.where: Song search overlay: empty state when the library has no songs

overlay.keyLabel.where: Song search overlay: musical key under a result
overlay.keyLabel.context: {key} is a musical key name like C or Bb (not translated).

overlay.added.where: Song search overlay: marker on a song already in the setlist

overlay.addToSetlist.where: Song search overlay: button on a result that opens the add-to-setlist picker
